### Read in Reactome Pathways (downloaded)

```{r}
REACT_relations_raw <- read_tsv("input/db/2026_08_ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt",
                                col_names = c("parent",
                                              "child"))

REACT_paths_raw <- read_tsv("input/db/2026_08_ReactomePathways.txt",
                                col_names = c("gs_id",
                                              "description",
                                              "species"))
```

```{r}
REACT_join <- left_join(REACT_relations_raw, REACT_paths_raw,
                            by = join_by(parent == gs_id)) %>%
  relocate(description, .after = parent) %>%
  rename(parent_description = description) %>%
  left_join(select(REACT_paths_raw,
                   gs_id, description),
                            by = join_by(child == gs_id)) %>%
  relocate(description, .after = child) %>%
  rename(child_description = description)

unique(REACT_join$species)

REACT_join_peeps <- REACT_join %>%
  filter(species == "Homo sapiens")
```

# Wrangling

### Protein Comparisons with ENTREZ & GENENAME

```{r}
# see BioIn_2025_12_v3.4.2_ClusterProfiler_EExAge_vis_testing_v1.Rmd for more info

protein_comp <- df %>%
  filter(is.na(issue)) %>% # keeps rows with issue == na (so comps that are ok)
  filter(!str_detect(log2FC, "Inf")) %>% # remove infinity/missing log2FC
  mutate(Label_trm = paste0(gsub("^[^_]*_", "", Label)), .after = Label)

# check 
head(protein_comp) 
colnames(protein_comp)


# ENTREZ
protein_comp_uni_gene <- unique(protein_comp$gene) # 8014

bitr_gn_2_entrez <- bitr(protein_comp_uni_gene,
                         fromType = "SYMBOL",
                         toType = "ENTREZID",
                         OrgDb = "org.Rn.eg.db") #3.39% failed to map... |3.72% v2




# SEE MY LEVELS BELOW
my_comp_levels = c("H_EE_vs_SH",
              "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_YNG",
              "HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_OLD",
              "A_YNG_vs_OLD",
              "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_EE_OLD",
              "HxA_SH_YNG_vs_SH_OLD",

              "HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"
)


# MAP ENTREZ TO UNIPROT PROT COMPS
protein_comp_entrez <- left_join(protein_comp, bitr_gn_2_entrez,
                                 by = join_by(gene == SYMBOL)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))  # remove non mapped - 64384 to 61952 


protein_comp_entrez$Label <- factor(protein_comp_entrez$Label,
                                  levels = my_comp_levels)
```

### Map nested .rda to master dfs & fix names

```{r}
##_KEGG_______
## Map KEGG to a MASTER DF
KEGG_tibs_df <- map_dfr(KEGG_gsea_EExAge_mssv3.2.2t1_cpv3.4.2t3$kegg_results_tib,
                        as.data.frame,
                        .id = "Label")  %>%
  mutate(Label_trm = paste0(gsub("^[^_]*_", "", Label)), .after = Label) %>%
  mutate(Description_2 = str_replace_all(Description, " and ", " & "), # & instead
         .after = Description) %>%
  left_join(KEGG_cat_anno, # join to KEGG subcategory data
            by = join_by(ID == gsid,
                         Description == name)) %>%
  mutate(subcategory_2 = str_replace_all(subcategory, " and ", " & ")) %>%
  mutate(obs_genes = str_count(core_enrichment, "/") + 1)

#Fix some KEGG description names  
#df$col[df$col == "old_val"] <- "new_val"  | SHORTEN NAME! 
KEGG_tibs_df$Description_2[KEGG_tibs_df$Description_2 == "Pathways of neurodegeneration - multiple diseases"] <- "Pathways of neurodegeneration - multiple"

KEGG_tibs_df$Description_2[KEGG_tibs_df$Description_2 == "Chemical carcinogenesis - reactive oxygen species"] <- "Chemical carcinogenesis - ROS"
  


##_REACTOME_______________
## MAP MSIG c2 REACTOME
REACT_tibs_df <- map_dfr(
  gsea_msig_c2_reactome_EExAge_mss3.2.2_t1_cp3.4.2$gsea_results_tib,
  as.data.frame,
  .id = "Label") %>%
  #shorted comparison label
  mutate(Label_trm = paste0(gsub("^[^_]*_", "", Label)), .after = Label) %>%
  #Shorten & mod Reactome Description label
  mutate(Description_2 = str_replace_all(Description, "REACTOME_", ""),
         .after = Description)  %>%
  mutate(Description_2 = str_replace_all(Description_2, "_AND_", "_&_"), # &
         .after = Description) %>%
  mutate(Description_2 = str_replace_all(Description_2, "_", " "), # _ to " "
         .after = Description) %>%
  left_join(select(REACTOME_genesets, # df
                   gs_name, gs_description, gs_exact_source, gs_url), # cols
            by = join_by(ID == gs_name)) %>% # 985
  left_join(REACT_join_peeps, by = join_by(gs_exact_source == child)) # 1001

  
  
  
```

## Functions

### Lolliplot

- <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/39801041/ggplot2-have-common-facet-bar-in-outer-facet-panel-in-3-way-plot>
- <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/19440069/ggplot2-facet-wrap-strip-color-based-on-variable-in-data-set>
- <https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79755989/changing-facet-strip-colour-by-grouping-variable-when-using-ggh4xfacet-manual>

```{r}
lolliplot <- function(data,
                      x_1 = Description, 
                      x_2 = NES, 
                      y = NES, 
                      fill_1 = NES,
                      # cat_color = NULL, # ONLY NEEDED FOR KEGG CATEGORIES 
                      alpha = p.adjust,
                      facet_formula = ~Label_trm,
                      size = setSize,
                      subtitle = NULL,
                      legend_pos = "none") {
  
  # NEED TO SHUFFLE HERE & THERE BUT WORKS
    strip <- strip_themed( # green for 1st 3 (housing) & Lavender for last 3 (age)
    background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c(
      "#AFCC9F", "#D4E4CB", "#D4E4CB", 
      "#BFBBD5", "#DDDCE9", "#DDDCE9")))
  
  
  lol <- ggplot(data,
                aes(x = reorder({{x_1}},{{x_2}}),
                    y = {{y}}
                    )) +
    
    geom_segment(aes(x = {{x_1}},
                     yend = {{y}}, y = 0,
                     alpha = {{alpha}}), color = "grey10", linewidth = 0.3) +
    
    geom_point(aes(alpha = {{alpha}},
                  size = {{size}},
                  fill = {{fill_1}}),
                  color ="grey10", shape = 21) +
    
    # scale_alpha(range = c(.95,.3)) + # rev alpha so darker = more sig | all
    scale_alpha(range = c(.99,.49)) + #  GO TRIM VERSION so matches others
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = 'grey20', linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Up", "Down"),
                     # values = c("#dc322f", "#268bd2"),
                     guide = 'none') + 
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3,8)) + # map size oflolly (set size)
    # scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,8),
    #      guide = guide_legend(nrow=1)) + # map size oflolly (set size) | GO BP
    

    # scale_fill_continuous_diverging("Blue-Red 2") + # colorspace
    scale_fill_gradient2(low="#4a6fe3", mid="#e2e2e2", high="#d33f6a",
                         midpoint = 0,
                        limits = c(-3.5, 3.5)) +
  
 
    
    # scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(width = 30)) + # break text | KEGG ver
     scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(width = 60)) + # break text |

    ylim(-4,4)+
  
    labs(subtitle = subtitle,
       y = 'NES' ) +
    
    coord_flip() + #fliptheplot
    

   
    # facet_wrap(facet_formula,
    #          space = 'free_x') +
     
    # facet_grid(facet_formula, # KEGG subcategory anno! half working ....
    #              space = "free", scales = "free") +
    
    facet_grid2(facet_formula,
                strip = strip, # custom strip colors
                space = "free", scales = "free", 
                labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20), # length of label
                drop = FALSE) + # dropfalse keeps any empty facets

    
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "#cbdec1"),
      # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = my_level_colors),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 7.5),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"), # or "cm", "in", etc.
      
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, color = "grey10",
                               vjust = 0, # 90, hj1 t/R, vj.5 cent
                               size = 8.5, face = 'italic'), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, color = "grey10",
                               size = 8, face = 'italic',
                               lineheight = .7), # <1 smaller distances breaks
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey10", size = 8.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey10", linewidth = 0.25),

    
    # legend.margin = margin(-10,-1,-5,-1), # (top, right, bot, left) | bottom ver
    legend.title = element_text(face = 'italic', size =8,
                                hjust = 1),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"), # posit answer to same height
    legend.text = element_text(margin = margin(l = 0)), # marg text & key
    legend.box.just = "right", # right justify legend box
    
    # # #FOR RIGHT LEGEND
    legend.margin = margin(0,0,0,-5), # (top, right, bot, left) | right ver
    legend.justification = "top", # for right ver
    
    legend.position = legend_pos,
    
    strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey10"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey10"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(.1, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.1)
    )
  
  
}
```

```{r}
for(kp in kegg_POI) {
  
# 1 - PREPARE THE DATA
  my_genes <- KEGG_tibs_df_6_entrez_split %>%
    filter(ID == kp) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  my_title <- KEGG_tibs_df_6_entrez_split %>%
    filter(ID == kp) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Description) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  my_prots <- protein_comp_entrez %>% # from MSstatsTMT protein comps w ENTREZ map
    filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%
    filter(gene %in% my_genes) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Label) %>%
    mutate(up = sum(log2FC > 0),
           down = sum(log2FC < 0)) 
  
  prot_sums <- my_prots %>% # this is needed to avoid overplotting
    dplyr::select(Label, up, down) %>%
    unique()
  
  mapped_totals <- my_prots %>%  # for mapped total
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(n_distinct(gene)) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  gs_size <- KEGG_tibs_df_6_entrez_split %>% # for geneset size
    filter(ID == kp) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(setSize) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  
  path_sig <- KEGG_tibs_df_6 %>% # GET DETAILS FOR ANNOTATING SIG 
    filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%
    filter(ID == kp) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Label) %>% 
    mutate(sig_val = case_when(
      p.adjust <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adjust <= 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.adjust <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      .default = "NA" )) # if bit there then NA (ns)
  
  
  # interesting... this step needed for some reason...
  path_sig_lab <-  path_sig %>% 
    dplyr::select(ID, Label, sig_val, NES) %>%
    unique() 
  
  my_lg_prot <- my_prots %>% #LABEL LEADING GENE???
    arrange(adj.pvalue) %>% # not quite - 6 most sig proteins
    slice_head(n = 7)
  
  
    strip <- strip_themed( # green for 1st 3 (housing) & Lavender for last 3 (age)
    background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c(
      "#AFCC9F", "#D4E4CB", "#D4E4CB",
      "#BFBBD5", "#DDDCE9", "#DDDCE9")))

    
  # _____________________________________
  # 2 - MAKE THE VOLCANO PLOTS!!!
  vol_plot <- protein_comp_entrez %>%
    filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%
    
    ggplot(aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue))) +
    
    
    # limits - rm 17 (but none are leading edge - shrunken for comparisons)
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2,2),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,7.75),
                       expand = c(0.04, 0)) +
    

    
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.15,
               color = "grey50", alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype = "dotted",
               linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey60", alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0),linetype = "solid",
               linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey40", alpha = 0.5) +
    

    ggrastr::geom_point_rast(aes(fill = case_when( # conditional ass for color mapping
      adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.05", # up sig .05
      adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.05", # down sig .05
      adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.1", # up 0.1
      adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.1", # down .1
      TRUE ~ "ns" ),
      alpha = case_when( # conditional ass for ALPHA mapping
        adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.05", # up sig .05
        adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.05", # down sig .05
        adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.1", # up 0.1
        adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.1", # down .1
        TRUE ~ "ns" )), # catch the rest
       size = 1.75, shape = 21, stroke = 0.05,
      raster.dpi = getOption("ggrastr.default.dpi", 330)) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", # coloring
                                  "royalblue3",
                                  "lightpink",
                                  "lightblue3",
                                  "grey80"),
                       breaks = c("up_adjp.05",
                                  "down_adjp.05",
                                  "up_adjp.1",
                                  "down_adjp.1",
                                  "ns"),
                       labels = c("\U2191 (adj.p <.05)",
                                  "\U2193 (adj.p <.05)",
                                  "\U2191 (adj.p <.1)",
                                  "\U2193 (adj.p <.1)",
                                  "ns")) +
    scale_alpha_manual( # alpha mapping
      values = c( # darker for more significant!
        up_adjp.05  = 0.3,
        down_adjp.05 = 0.3,
        up_adjp.1   = 0.3,
        down_adjp.1 = 0.3,
        ns = 0.1
      )) +
    
    
    
    geom_point_rast(data = my_prots, # ORGANE POINTS | ggrastr
                    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue)),
                    alpha = .5, size = 1.75, shape = 21,
                    fill = "#E17C05FF", color = "#FCA842FF",
                    raster.dpi = getOption("ggrastr.default.dpi", 330)) + 
    
    geom_text_repel(data =  my_lg_prot, # TOP 6 MOST SIG ANNO
                    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue),
                        label = gene,
                        color = log2FC > 0), # color mapping (see below)
                    force = 1.5, nudge_y = .2,
                    max.overlaps = 30, size = 2.1, # gene text on points
                    min.segment.length = .5, segment.alpha = 0.3,
                    segment.size = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
                    # nudge_x = 0.155) +

    
    # NUM SIG UP & DOWN! | use sep df, overwise overplots
    geom_text(data = prot_sums, # up 
              aes(label = paste0(up, " \U2191")), 
              x = 1.35, y = 7.3, size = 3.2, color = "firebrick") + 
    geom_text(data = prot_sums, # down
              aes(label = paste0(down, " \U2193")),
              x = -1.4, y = 7.3, size = 3.2, color = "royalblue3") + 
    
    
    geom_text(data = path_sig_lab, # GSEA SIGNIFICANCE LABEL
              aes(label = paste0(sig_val),
                  y = 6.2,
                  x = ifelse(NES > 0, 1.525, -1.525), # side if neg or pos
                  color = NES > 0), # col - TRUE FALSE 
              size = 3.3) +
    scale_color_manual( # based on TRUE FALSE give color! 
      values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick", `FALSE` = "royalblue3")) +
    
    
    
    
    labs(subtitle = paste0("KEGG - ", my_title,
                           " (", mapped_totals, "/", gs_size, ")")) +
    
    
    # facet_wrap(~Label, nrow = 1) + 
    facet_wrap2(~Label, nrow = 1,
                strip = strip
                ) + 
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = my_level_colors),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, vjust = 0, color = "grey10"),
      axis.title = element_text(size =7, color = "grey10"),
      axis.text = element_text(size =6.5, color = "grey10"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6.2, color = "grey10"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey10"),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey10")
    )
  
  print(vol_plot)
  
  # _____________________________________
  # 3 - SAVE THE PLOTS
  kegg_volcano_list[[kp]] <- vol_plot
  
  # _____________________________________
  # 4 - PRINT OUT PLOTS - all
  # ggsave(
  #   filename = file.path(kegg_out_dir , paste0("2026_10_", kp, "_map_vol.pdf")),
  #   plot = vol_plot,
  #   width = 7.6, height = 1.9, units = "in",
  #   device = cairo_pdf
  # )
  # 
  # ggsave(
  #   filename = file.path(kegg_out_dir , paste0("2026_10_", kp, "_map_vol.png")),
  #   plot = vol_plot,
  #   width = 7.6, height = 1.9, units = "in",
  #   dpi = 330
  # )

  
  print(paste0("Done for ", kp, "! :D"))
  
}
```

#### REACT_LOOP

```{r}
##___SWITCH_IN_&_OUT____________________________________
# for (rct in REACT_TOP_LVL) {

# for(rct in p1_reactome_list) { # P1 - NT BDNF, dna rep, death, CA2+
# for(rct in p2_reactome_list) { # P2 - Gene Expression & Protein synthesis & processing
# for(rct in p3_reactome_list) { # P3 - MITOCHONDRIA + METABOLISM-LIPIDS+AA+CARB+NUCLEOT
for(rct in p4_reactome_list) { # P4 - Neuron & Synapse + CC-ECM Rho 
    
# for (rct in REACT_POI) { # General 
  

# 1 - PREPARE THE DATA
  my_genes <- REACT_tibs_df_6_entrez_split %>%
    filter(ID == rct) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  my_title <- REACT_tibs_df_6_entrez_split %>%
    filter(ID == rct) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Description) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  my_prots <- protein_comp_entrez %>% # from MSstatsTMT protein comps w ENTREZ map
    filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%
    filter(gene %in% my_genes) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Label) %>%
    mutate(up = sum(log2FC > 0),
           down = sum(log2FC < 0)) 
  
  prot_sums <- my_prots %>% # this is needed to avoid overplotting
    dplyr::select(Label, up, down) %>%
    unique()
  
  
   mapped_totals <- my_prots %>%  # for mapped total
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(n_distinct(gene)) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  gs_size <- REACT_tibs_df_6_entrez_split %>% # for geneset size
    filter(ID == rct) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(setSize) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  
  path_sig <- REACT_tibs_df_6 %>% # GET DETAILS FOR ANNOTATING SIG 
    filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%
    filter(ID == rct) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Label) %>% 
    mutate(sig_val = case_when(
      p.adjust <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adjust <= 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.adjust <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      .default = "NA" )) # if bit there then NA (ns)
  
  
  # interesting... this step needed for some reason...
  path_sig_lab <-  path_sig %>% 
    dplyr::select(ID, Label, sig_val, NES) %>%
    unique() 
  
  my_lg_prot <- my_prots %>% #LABEL LEADING GENE???
    arrange(adj.pvalue) %>% # not quite - 6 most sig proteins
    slice_head(n = 7)
  
  
    strip <- strip_themed( # green for 1st 3 (housing) & Lavender for last 3 (age)
    background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c(
      "#AFCC9F", "#D4E4CB", "#D4E4CB",
      "#BFBBD5", "#DDDCE9", "#DDDCE9")))

    
  # _____________________________________
  # 2 - MAKE THE VOLCANO PLOTS!!!
  vol_plot <- protein_comp_entrez %>%
    filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue))) +
    
    
    # limits - rm 17 (but none are leading edge - shrunken for comparisons)
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2,2),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,7.75),
                       # limits = c(0,6),
                       expand = c(0.04, 0)) +
    
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.15,
               color = "grey50", alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype = "dotted",
               linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey60", alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0),linetype = "solid",
               linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey40", alpha = 0.5) +


    ggrastr::geom_point_rast(aes(fill = case_when( # conditional ass for color mapping
      adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.05", # up sig .05
      adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.05", # down sig .05
      adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.1", # up 0.1
      adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.1", # down .1
      TRUE ~ "ns" ),
      alpha = case_when( # conditional ass for ALPHA mapping
        adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.05", # up sig .05
        adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.05", # down sig .05
        adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.1", # up 0.1
        adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.1", # down .1
        TRUE ~ "ns" )), # catch the rest
       size = 1.75, shape = 21, stroke = 0.05,
      raster.dpi = getOption("ggrastr.default.dpi", 330)) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", # coloring
                                  "royalblue3",
                                  "lightpink",
                                  "lightblue3",
                                  "grey80"),
                       breaks = c("up_adjp.05",
                                  "down_adjp.05",
                                  "up_adjp.1",
                                  "down_adjp.1",
                                  "ns"),
                       labels = c("\U2191 (adj.p <.05)",
                                  "\U2193 (adj.p <.05)",
                                  "\U2191 (adj.p <.1)",
                                  "\U2193 (adj.p <.1)",
                                  "ns")) +
    scale_alpha_manual( # alpha mapping
      values = c( # darker for more significant!
        up_adjp.05  = 0.3,
        down_adjp.05 = 0.3,
        up_adjp.1   = 0.3,
        down_adjp.1 = 0.3,
        ns = 0.1)) +
    
    
    geom_point_rast(data = my_prots, # ORGANE POINTS | ggrastr
                    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue)),
                    alpha = .5, size = 1.75, shape = 21,
                    fill = "#E17C05FF", color = "#FCA842FF",
                    raster.dpi = getOption("ggrastr.default.dpi", 330)) + 
    
    geom_text_repel(data =  my_lg_prot, # TOP 6 MOST SIG ANNO
                    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue),
                        label = gene,
                        color = log2FC > 0), # color mapping (see below)
                      force = 1.5, nudge_y = .2,
                    max.overlaps = 30, size = 2.1, # gene text on points
                    min.segment.length = .5, segment.alpha = 0.3,
                    segment.size = 0.2, alpha = 0.9) +
                    # nudge_x = 0.155) +

    
    
    # NUM SIG UP & DOWN! | use sep df, overwise overplots
    geom_text(data = prot_sums, # up 
              aes(label = paste0(up, " \U2191")), 
              x = 1.35, y = 7.27, size = 3.2, color = "firebrick") + 
    geom_text(data = prot_sums, # down
              aes(label = paste0(down, " \U2193")),
              x = -1.4, y = 7.27, size = 3.2, color = "royalblue3") + 
    
    
    geom_text(data = path_sig_lab, # GSEA SIGNIFICANCE LABEL
              aes(label = paste0(sig_val),
                  y = 6.20,
                  x = ifelse(NES > 0, 1.525, -1.525), # side if neg or pos
                  color = NES > 0), # col - TRUE FALSE 
              size = 3.3) +
    scale_color_manual( # based on TRUE FALSE give color! 
      values = c(`TRUE` = "firebrick", `FALSE` = "royalblue3")) +
    

    labs(subtitle = paste0(my_title," (", mapped_totals, "/", gs_size, ")")) +
    
    # facet_wrap(~Label, nrow = 1) + 
    facet_wrap2(~Label, nrow = 1,
                strip = strip) + 
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = my_level_colors),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, vjust = 0, color = "grey10"),
      axis.title = element_text(size =7, color = "grey10"),
      axis.text = element_text(size =6.5, color = "grey10"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6.2, color = "grey10"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey10"),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey10")
    )
  
  print(vol_plot)

  # _____________________________________
  # 3 - SAVE THE PLOTS - selected in re-run
  # reactome_volcano_list[[rct]] <- vol_plot
  # reactome_TOP_volcano_list[[rct]] <- vol_plot
  # p1_reactome_volcano_list[[rct]] <- vol_plot
  # p2_reactome_volcano_list[[rct]] <- vol_plot
  # p3_reactome_volcano_list[[rct]] <- vol_plot
   p4_reactome_volcano_list[[rct]] <- vol_plot
  
  # _____________________________________
  # 4 - PRINT OUT PLOTS - all
  # ggsave(
  #   filename = file.path(react_out_dir, paste0("2026_09_", rct, "_map_vol.pdf")),
  #   plot = vol_plot,
  #   width = 7.6, height = 1.9, units = "in",
  #   device = cairo_pdf
  # )
  # 
  # ggsave(
  #   filename = file.path(react_out_dir, paste0("2026_09_", rct, "_map_vol.png")),
  #   plot = vol_plot,
  #   width = 7.6, height = 1.9, units = "in",
  #   dpi = 330
  # )
  
  
  print(paste0("Done for ", rct))
  
}
```
